**Key Details:**

- **Implementation Timeline**: The fee will apply from January 26 2026

The implementation reflects OpenAI's effort to monetize its commerce capabilities as "agentic commerce" grows rapidly.

OpenAI unveiled Instant Checkout, a new ChatGPT feature that lets users buy stuff directly through its chatbot. On September 29, 2025, Shopify and OpenAI announced commerce in ChatGPT.

ChatGPT will charge Shopify merchants a 4% fee on sales made through its Instant Checkout functionality. However, it's important to note that Instant Checkout is free to users and will not affect their prices.

The feature initially supports single-item purchases directly from Etsy sellers, but support for more than one million Shopify merchants is coming soon. It's also only available to U.S. ChatGPT Plus, Pro and Free users at this time.
